howto.name: Upload your PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Add annotations
howto.text: Use the toolbar to add highlights, underlines, strikethroughs, sticky notes, and text boxes. Each annotation has a position, page, content, and color.

howto.name: Save and download
howto.text: Click Save. Annotations are added as standard PDF annotation objects — they appear in every PDF reader and can be edited later.

faq.a: By default no — they remain as editable annotations. If you want them permanently baked into the page, run the Flatten tool afterwards.
